title: Cardinality of a lifted subset
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a finite subset of a set of $n$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a finite subset of $J$. The image of $T$ in the full coordinate set has the same cardinality as $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the coordinate set of size $n$
